3371230.title: Iksan Mahan Culture Festival
3371230.overview: A history festival celebrating Iksan's roots in Mahan — the ancient confederacy that preceded the Baekje kingdom — with performances and programs asserting the city's place as Korea's center of Mahan heritage.

2733405.title: Seodaemun Heritage Night Tour
2733405.overview: A night festival at Independence Park, where Korea's independence history is layered thick: Dongnimmun Arch, Seodaemun Prison History Hall, and the Provisional Government Memorial host literary-themed programs weaving together the writers and works of the independence era.

3115337.title: Wonju Pet Culture Festival: Animal University
3115337.overview: A pet festival built on a university theme — owners enroll in one of three 'departments' for themed games, national dog-sports demonstrations, a pet orchestra performance, a senior-model-and-rescue-dog walking show, and behavior classes.

142204.title: Korea Drama Festival 2025
142204.overview: A K-drama festival against the backdrop of Jinju Fortress and the Nam River: a red-carpet event and drama awards with hallyu stars, forums with actors, writers, and directors, an OST music festa, and recreated drama-set experiences.

3367459.title: World Flower & Culture Festival: Play at the Lake
3367459.overview: A night-tourism flower festival at Ilsan Lake Park in Goyang, layering world cultures and K-culture programming over the city's famous flower exhibition grounds.
3367459.place: Goyang Flower Exhibition Hall, Ilsan Lake Park

3370464.title: Gumi Industrial Complex Festival
3370464.overview: A culture-tech festival inside the Bang-rim factory of Gumi's national industrial complex, reinterpreting the city's industrial heritage through art: exhibitions and workshops by day, performances and media shows by night.
3370464.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · Gyeongsangbuk-do · Gumi City

3364857.title: Gunsan Jjamppong Festival
3364857.overview: A noodle festival for Gunsan's claim to fame: jjamppong, the spicy seafood noodle soup that evolved here from the Chinese-Korean chomamyeon of the port's overseas-Chinese community. Chinese-restaurant booths, jjamppong-themed programs, and stages fill the Baeknyeon Plaza.

3536596.title: Pocheon Hantangang World Drone Festival
3536596.overview: Korea's largest drone festival at the Hantangang Eco Landscape Complex: a 6,000-drone light show — the country's biggest — with artist collaboration stages, the world's first high-speed drone racing over a river gorge, drone soccer, a world food festival, and camping festa.

3540329.title: Hangeul Day Celebration at King Sejong's Tomb
3540329.overview: Hangeul Day marked where it means most — at Yeongneung, the tomb of King Sejong who created the alphabet. Kids' musicals, calligraphy and graffiti workshops, traditional snack making, exhibition of national calligraphy award winners, and small concerts across the royal tomb grounds.

3546696.title: Tree Hundred Festival Uljin
3546696.overview: A recovery-and-healing festival born from the great 2022 Uljin forest fire: music and comedy stages plus hands-on programs that thank the volunteers of the disaster response and turn attention to forest regeneration.

506708.title: Yangyang Songi Mushroom Festival
506708.overview: Yangyang's autumn celebration of songi (pine mushroom) — Korea's most prized fungus. Buy same-day harvested mushrooms at source, join a mushroom treasure hunt, and eat through the songi gourmet garden, with night concerts on the Namdaecheon riverside.
506708.fee: Free entry (treasure hunt 30,000 won · gourmet garden 15,000–20,000 won)

3113548.title: Seoul Living Arts Festival
3113548.overview: Five hundred citizen artists take the stages of Nodeul Island for Seoul's flagship amateur-arts festival — proof that the city's arts scene runs deeper than professionals — with an artist-farmer night market and family programs across the island.
3113548.sponsor: Seoul Metropolitan Government · Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture

3544873.title: Yuseong Reading Festival
3544873.overview: An open-air reading festival on the lawn of Yurim Park in Daejeon — books, culture, and rest in one outdoor weekend timed to the Chuseok holiday.

3008665.title: Pocheon Youth Festival
3008665.overview: Pocheon's sixth youth festival, planned by a young residents' committee: opening performances, experience booths, busking, and headline concerts at the city stadium under the slogan 'Resonance — the next hour is ours'.

3367338.title: K-Wave Dance Festival 2025
3367338.overview: Around 100 overseas dance fans travel to Korea on their own initiative to perform K-dance on the floating-island stage of Banpo Hangang Park, joined by influencers, professional companies, and open citizen programs — 17 Korean regions and 193 countries connected by dance.

3016265.title: UNICA Korea International Film Festival 2025
3016265.overview: Two days of screenings from UNICA — the international non-commercial film federation founded on UNESCO principles in 1931 — showing films chosen for beauty and humanity over violence and sensation, at CGV Gyeongsan. Free.

3382045.title: Hanbok Love Incheon Citizens' Festival
3382045.overview: A hanbok festival on the lawn of Incheon City Hall: traditional and modern hanbok fashion shows — including one for pets — plus traditional performances and try-on programs promoting Korea's national dress.

3548994.title: Green Chips Festival
3548994.overview: Seoul's sustainability festival in the Yeonnam-Yeonhui neighborhoods, styled as a walkable 'Green Chips Town': sustainable-design brand pop-ups, a village-hotel concept space, and shop-in-shop collaborations with local stores make eco-living browsable like a stroll.
3548994.place: News Museum Yeonnam and neighborhood venues

2561700.title: Gwangju Seochang Silver Grass Festival
2561700.overview: A riverside healing festival among the natural eulalia (silver grass) fields of the Yeongsan River — sunset walks through the reeds, performances, hands-on programs, and even a national spacing-out contest, in the city's only rural-scenery quarter.
2561700.place: Yeongsan River bike path center area

506544.title: Bonghwa Songi Mushroom Festival
506544.overview: Running since 1997 in the deep-forest county of Bonghwa, whose pine mushrooms — grown only above 600m in pristine woodland — are considered Korea's finest. Mushroom-hunting experiences, songi cuisine tastings, and produce markets along the Naeseongcheon stream.

141252.title: Kim Sakkat Culture Festival
141252.overview: A literary festival honoring Kim Sakkat, the wandering 19th-century satirical poet who traveled Korea in a bamboo hat — held at his literary hall in the Yeongwol valley where he is buried, with poetry events and performances.
141252.sponsor: Yeongwol Foundation for Culture and Tourism

2865258.title: Nowon Book Festival
2865258.overview: An open-air library along the Gyeongchun Line Forest Trail — the old railway turned linear park — running weekend evenings for weeks under the theme 'romance guaranteed': books among the trees, author concerts, and performances where trains once ran.

2559006.title: Mokpo Heritage Night Tour
2559006.overview: A hundred-year time trip through Mokpo's modern-history quarter — one of Korea's densest concentrations of early-1900s port architecture — with night lighting, performances, and programs among the colonial-era buildings.

527789.title: Suncheon Naganeupseong Folk Culture Festival
527789.overview: A folk festival inside Naganeupseong — the 600-year-old walled town where residents still live within Joseon-era ramparts and thatched houses. Daily life of the dynasty is reenacted where it actually happened.

3018117.title: Jeonpo Coffee Festival
3018117.overview: Busan's first coffee festival, born after the New York Times named Jeonpo Cafe Street a place to visit in 2017. Local and guest roasters — including barista booths from Japan and Taiwan — fill the cafe alleys with tastings, performances, and events.
3018117.place: Jeonpo Cafe Street and side alleys

2852354.title: Cheongdo World Comedy Art Festival
2852354.overview: Korea's comedy festival in Cheongdo — 'the sacred ground of Korean comedy' — with top comedians, an acrobatic hip-hop troupe from abroad, magic shows, and trot-star stages, held jointly with the Cheongdo Bansi Persimmon Festival. Free.

3380662.title: Hwasun Dolmen Autumn Flower Festival
3380662.overview: Cosmos, chrysanthemums, and sunflowers bloom across the UNESCO World Heritage dolmen fields of Hwasun — Bronze Age tombs and autumn flowers in one frame, with prehistoric-themed programs and local signature snacks. Entry 5,000 won, refunded in local gift certificates.

3021908.title: Seoul Ballet Festival: Seoul International Ballet Week
3021908.overview: International and Korean ballet companies — including the Czech National Ballet of Ostrava — perform free on the lakeside stage of Seokchon Lake, bringing world-class dance out of the theater and into the park.

1399407.title: Cheongdo Bansi Persimmon Festival
1399407.overview: A harvest festival for Cheongdo's seedless bansi persimmon: sales halls of the prized fruit, persimmon playgrounds and food zones, persimmon-dye workshops and picking experiences, plus band stages — held alongside the comedy festival. Free.

2759249.title: Gyeongsan Jujube Festival & Farm Fair
2759249.overview: Gyeongsan grows 30 percent of Korea's jujubes, and its harvest fair sells the new crop alongside jujube foods, a national nongak (farmers' music) festival, and full days of stages and family programs.

623666.title: Pocheon Sanjeong Lake Silver Grass Festival
623666.overview: The 28th silver-grass festival at Sanjeong Lake, marking the lake's 100th year: eulalia fields on Myeongseongsan mountain in full autumn color, craft and letter-to-the-future programs by day, and floating fireworks theater, lantern displays, and silent disco by night.
623666.place: Sanjeong Lake and Myeongseongsan grass fields

3400856.title: Global Content Festival in Suncheon
3400856.overview: A content-industry festival on Suncheon's Ocheon Green Plaza — 'All Content Garden' — mixing public festivities (drone shows, anime OST concerts, sing-alongs) with business markets and animation awards connecting creators, companies, and students.

2767541.title: 19th Jeonbuk Science Festival
2767541.overview: Jeonbuk's flagship science festival at Jeonju University: some 100 hands-on programs from research institutes, schools, and companies — robots, VR, competitions, and science shows across themed halls for families.
2767541.sponsor: Jeonbuk Province · Provincial Office of Education

2862358.title: Nowon Moonlight Walk Light Sculpture Festival
2862358.overview: A month-long public-art light festival drawing over a million visitors a year: 2km of the Danghyeoncheon stream becomes an open-air museum of some 30 light sculptures and media artworks by 18 Korean and international teams, this year themed 'everyone's moon'. Free, nightly.

3014969.title: Culture Month National Festival (Seogwipo)
3014969.overview: Korea's national Culture Month event, hosted by a different city each October since 1990 — the 2025 edition landed in Seogwipo, running with the Chilsimni Festival: concerts, food, markets, and a theme performance drawing on Jeju's creation goddess Seolmundae Halmang around Cheonjiyeon Falls.
3014969.place: Cheonjiyeon Falls area and old downtown
3014969.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · Seogwipo City

1398980.title: Oeam Village Straw & Grass Culture Festival
1398980.overview: A farming-culture festival in Oeam Folk Village — a living 600-year-old hamlet of stone walls and thatched roofs. Straw craft, cauldron-rice cooking in old manor houses, traditional funeral-bier processions, and thatch-laying demonstrations keep vanishing folkways in practice.

1692948.title: Sim Hun Sangnok Culture Festival
1692948.overview: Dangjin's literary festival, held since 1977 for Sim Hun — resistance poet, novelist of 'Sangnoksu' (The Evergreens), and film director — carrying his rural-enlightenment spirit through programs where literature and culture meet.

2405329.title: Jongno K Festival
2405329.overview: Jongno's brand festival since 2016, celebrating its 10th year by growing from a hanbok festival into a full traditional-arts celebration on Gwanghwamun Square — fashion shows, exhibitions, and hands-on programs over a ten-day festival week.

3563531.title: Guri Light Festival
3563531.overview: Jangja Lake Park glows through late autumn with light sculptures and photo zones built on the lake's dragon legend and winter fairy tales, plus weekend programs — LED jwibulnori spinning, face painting, bubbles — and lakeside concerts.

2618971.title: Guro Youth Festival
2618971.overview: A tenth-anniversary youth festival planned and run by Guro's teen council 'Greennarae', themed 'Own Game, Own GURO': sports reimagined as festival games, club performances, a career fair, science fair, and a K-pop guest stage.

3018929.title: Gimpo La Veniche Festival
3018929.overview: A festival at La Veniche, Gimpo's Venice-styled canal town: busking from boats on the water, Venetian mask photo zones, citizen programs, a headline concert, and a fireworks finale over the canal.
3018929.place: La Veniche canal and Hangang Central Park

3548867.title: Daegu Dong-gu Harmony Festival (Dududadong)
3548867.overview: The autumn finale of Dong-gu's seasonal festival series: a sports day, national trot singing contest, harmony concert, pop-up playground, lifelong-learning fair, and laser survival games at Yulha Sports Park.

2560781.title: Dongincheon Romance Festival
2560781.overview: A nostalgia festival on Dongincheon Station's north plaza revisiting the district's boom years: a two-day 'romance market' with the area's traditional markets, busking, retro cinema with the old Mirim Theater, and folk and pop concerts by veteran singers.

635451.title: Mungyeong Apple Festival
635451.overview: Mungyeong's mountain-grown Gamhong apples — averaging 16.5 brix, among Korea's sweetest — star in a harvest festival at the foot of Mungyeong Saejae pass, with tastings, sales, and events in the historic gateway park.

3113222.title: Whole Family Book Festival
3113222.overview: The Seoul education office's reading festival since 2013, in the garden of Jeongdok Library in Bukchon: family reading awards, performances, creative book-linked crafts, and traditional culture programs run with local bookstores and school reading clubs.

3547380.title: Incheon Living Culture Festival
3547380.overview: One hundred amateur culture clubs from across Incheon share performances, crafts, and exhibitions in Wolmi Park for a single day — a citizen-made festival about culture as everyday life.
3547380.sponsor: Incheon Foundation for Arts and Culture

2867300.title: Pyeongtaek Wonpyeong Naru Silver Grass Festival
2867300.overview: An urban silver-grass festival on the reed fields below Gunmun Bridge in Pyeongtaek — sunset light through the eulalia, evening strolls, and hands-on programs in the heart of the city.
